Cleaner.Title: 🧹 DEEP SSD CLEANING & DISK CLEANER
Cleaner.Description: Safely clean caches, temporary files and free up space on the system drive
Cleaner.ConfirmAll: Clean all detected caches, temp files and outdated data (including Windows.old)? Deep WinSxS compression (DISM) runs separately.

clean_gpu_shaders.Name: GPU shader cache (DirectX / NVIDIA / AMD / Intel / Vulkan)
clean_gpu_shaders.Description: Clears the compiled graphics driver shader cache. Fixes micro-stutters and artifacts after driver updates.

clean_gpu_driver_installers.Name: NVIDIA / AMD driver installer leftovers
clean_gpu_driver_installers.Description: Removes temporary extracted GPU driver installation packages.

clean_game_launchers_cache.Name: Launcher web cache (Steam / Epic Games / Battle.net / EA / Ubisoft)
clean_game_launchers_cache.Description: Clears temporary web cache of built-in launcher browsers.

clean_user_temp.Name: User temporary files (%TEMP%)
clean_user_temp.Description: Installer leftovers, temporary extracted archives and user session cache.

clean_win_temp.Name: Windows system cache (C:\Windows\Temp)
clean_win_temp.Description: Temporary system files of Windows background services.

clean_wu_cache.Name: Downloaded updates cache (SoftwareDistribution)
clean_wu_cache.Description: Windows Update packages that were already successfully installed.

clean_cbs_logs.Name: Component servicing logs (CBS & Setup Logs)
clean_cbs_logs.Description: Outdated component servicing logs after SFC/DISM and update installation.

clean_delivery_opt.Name: Delivery Optimization cache
clean_delivery_opt.Description: Cache of the Windows update peer-distribution service over the local network.

clean_recycle_bin.Name: Windows Recycle Bin (all drives)
clean_recycle_bin.Description: Permanently empties the Recycle Bin on all connected drives.

clean_browser_cache.Name: Chromium browsers cache (Chrome / Edge / Brave / Opera / Opera GX)
clean_browser_cache.Description: Clears only temporary media, script and GPU cache. Keeps all passwords, history and active sessions.

clean_messengers_media.Name: Messenger cache (Discord / Telegram / Spotify)
clean_messengers_media.Description: Clears temporary audio, image and streamed video caches.

clean_store_winget.Name: Microsoft Store and WinGet cache
clean_store_winget.Description: Clears downloaded installer packages and temporary store/package-manager folders.

clean_dism_winsxs.Name: Deep WinSxS compression (DISM Component Cleanup)
clean_dism_winsxs.Description: Compresses and removes outdated system component versions in the WinSxS store.

clean_firefox_cache.Name: Firefox cache (cache2 / startupCache / shader-cache)
clean_firefox_cache.Description: Clears the temporary web page, shader and startup cache of Firefox. Keeps passwords, bookmarks and history.

clean_inetcache.Name: Internet Explorer / Legacy Edge cache (INetCache)
clean_inetcache.Description: Temporary internet files of the legacy browser and the Windows shell web cache.

clean_prefetch.Name: Prefetch (Windows preload files)
clean_prefetch.Description: Removes old Prefetch .pf files that Windows uses to speed up application startup.

clean_dev_pkg_caches.Name: Package manager caches (pip / npm / NuGet)
clean_dev_pkg_caches.Description: Temporary downloaded Python (pip), Node (npm) and .NET (NuGet) packages that can be re-downloaded.

clean_windows_old.Name: Windows.old folder (Windows upgrade leftovers)
clean_windows_old.Description: Backup copy of the previous Windows version after a major upgrade.
